name: Copper Dragon’s Trap Mastery
body:
You gain the copper dragon’s mastery of traps.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic bloodline (must choose copper dragon), 1st-level dragon disciple

Benefit: You add half your dragon disciple level (minimum +1) to Craft (traps) checks and Perception checks made to locate traps, and you can also use Disable Device to disarm magic traps as if you had the rogue’s trapfinding class feature. This feat does not grant you the other benefits of the trapfinding class feature.

Normal: Normally only a rogue can use Disable Device to disarm magic traps.
